bulletins.title: USDMA Emergency Dispatch: Joshimath-Badrinath NH-7 Segment Km 245 Blocked
bulletins.description: Debris fall at Marwari bridge approach; BRO teams mobilizing heavy excavators. Diverting light vehicles via Helang bypass.

bulletins.title: USDMA Advisory: Mandakini Catchment High Silt & Discharge Warning
bulletins.description: Intense localized cloudburst in Kedarnath upper peaks; river stage rising. Habitations in Guptkashi and Sonprayag to maintain high alert.
